text: College softball, 2008. Sara Tucholsky hit *the first home run of her career.* Rounding first base, *her knee gave out.* She couldn't walk. If her teammates helped her, she would be out. So two players from the other team picked her up and *carried her around the bases,* letting her touch each one. That home run knocked their own team out of the playoffs. Like if you agree.
title: Carried Around the Bases by Rivals 🤝❤️
